patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three distinct swing lows visible: left shoulder near 65000, head near 62200, right shoulder near 64200. Price broke above neckline resistance around 65500-66000 and is currently retesting the breakout level at approximately 65528.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Sharp upward impulse from approximately 64200 to 66000 followed by tight sideways consolidation near 65500-65800, forming a potential flag pattern.

patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish lower highs and lows to bullish after price broke above prior swing high near 65500, made a higher low around 64200, and rallied to approximately 66000.
